## queries/analysis/bottleneck_narrators.cypher [cypher]
Top-N narrators by betweenness centrality — identifies madār (common-link) narrators
labels: Narrator
clauses: MATCH, WHERE, RETURN

## queries/analysis/geographic_flow.cypher [cypher]
Transmission paths mapped to narrator locations — tracks geographic flow of hadith.
labels: Location, Narrator
rels: TRANSMITTED_TO
clauses: MATCH, WHERE, WITH, RETURN

## queries/analysis/narrator_volume.cypher [cypher]
Hadith count per narrator, broken down by collection and composite grade.
labels: Collection, Hadith, Narrator
rels: APPEARS_IN, NARRATED
clauses: MATCH, WITH, WHERE, RETURN

## queries/analysis/political_correlation.cypher [cypher]
Succession/imamate topic hadiths grouped by narrator's active caliphate period.
labels: Hadith, HistoricalEvent, Narrator
rels: ACTIVE_DURING, NARRATED
clauses: MATCH, WHERE, OPTIONAL MATCH, WITH, RETURN

## queries/analysis/school_clusters.cypher [cypher]
Louvain communities annotated with aggregate narrator attributes.
labels: Narrator
clauses: MATCH, WHERE, WITH, UNWIND, RETURN

## queries/analysis/sectarian_parallels.cypher [cypher]
Hadiths that exist in both Sunni and Shia corpora via PARALLEL_OF relationships.
labels: Collection, Hadith
rels: APPEARS_IN, PARALLEL_OF
clauses: MATCH, WHERE, RETURN

## queries/analysis/temporal_anomalies.cypher [cypher]
Chains where narrator death dates make transmission impossible.
labels: Narrator
rels: TRANSMITTED_TO
clauses: MATCH, WHERE, RETURN

## queries/migrations/remove_user_nodes.cypher [cypher]
Migration: Remove USER node indexes and constraints from Neo4j
clauses: DROP INDEX, DROP CONSTRAINT

## queries/validation/chain_integrity.cypher [cypher]
Verify TRANSMITTED_TO paths form valid chains (no cycles, connected)
labels: Narrator
rels: TRANSMITTED_TO
clauses: MATCH, WHERE, RETURN

## queries/validation/collection_coverage.cypher [cypher]
Compare expected vs actual hadith counts per collection
labels: Collection, Hadith
rels: APPEARS_IN
clauses: MATCH, OPTIONAL MATCH, WITH, RETURN

## queries/validation/orphan_narrators.cypher [cypher]
Find narrator nodes with no relationships
labels: Narrator
clauses: MATCH, WHERE, RETURN
